scope: The cinematic homepage redesign of October 15, 2026 (site/src/pages/index.astro), drafted from the claim check in docs/website-switch-redesign-claims-draft-2026-10-15.md (PR #825). Every Blanc claim resolves to evidence at the immutable v1.34.0 tag. The Chrome column is sourced from Google's own pages, read October 15, 2026, and recorded in externalClaims. labels lists the page's headings, names and link text that make no claim of their own. The homepage wording this redesign retired is recorded as supersededClaims in docs/website-revamp-claims-v1.27.json, docs/website-v1.32-claims.json and docs/website-v1.33-claims.json.

brand.qualification: Approved brand tagline and call to action; not a feature claim.

island.qualification: Public desktop v1.34.0. The resting Island sits in a reserved 68px band (--strip-h) in the default horizontal layout; vertical tabs (View → Tab Layout) add a sidebar. Only the expanded Island overlays the page. Never say the resting Island floats over the page.

platforms.qualification: Public v1.34.0 ships for macOS 13 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows 10 or later (x64) and 64-bit Linux as an AppImage. Desktop only: no phone or tablet apps.

blocking.qualification: adblockEnabled defaults to true, so Blanc Blocker (Ghostery's engine with the bundled, hash-pinned EasyList and EasyPrivacy snapshots) is on from the first launch. Blocking reduces known ads and tracking; coverage is not universal.

ublock.qualification: Full uBlock Origin 1.75.0 is an optional provider for regular tabs on Apple Silicon, native Intel Mac, Windows x64 and Linux x64, chosen from the Island's shield; not under Rosetta. Changing providers needs a restart, private tabs keep Blanc Blocker, and it is not general extension support.

memory.qualification: Measured October 15, 2026 by the owner with the harness above on one Apple Silicon Mac (macOS 27.2, 8 GiB RAM) with Blanc 1.34.0 and Chrome 155.0.8059.80: the six ad-heavy pages in workloads.json (Forbes, CNN, The Verge, Daily Mail, Fox News, Speedtest), fresh profiles, no extensions, three repetitions, median of phys_footprint summed across each browser's process tree. Committed run: bench/memory/results/memory-2026-10-15T06-03-46-052Z.{json,md}; test/unit/public-truth.test.js recomputes the medians. Brave, which also blocks by default, used 1.5 GiB against Blanc's 1.7 GiB, and that stays beside the figure. Blanc with its blocker off (5.4 GiB, range 5.4–5.6) and Chrome (5.7 GiB, range 5.4–6.5) overlap: never say blocker-off Blanc beats Chrome. 1.7 of 5.7 is 29%: under a third, not a quarter.

license.qualification: Blanc's own code is MIT. The Blanc name, logos and identity assets in ASSET-LICENSE.md stay reserved, and third-party material keeps its own terms. Never call the whole repository blanket MIT.

groupsAndSpaces.qualification: Named groups and Blanc Spaces are user-directed: Blanc never groups or organizes tabs by itself. Spaces are free for everyone since October 2026 and are not synced.

privateTabs.qualification: Private tabs use a non-persistent session; its cookies, storage, cache and history are gone when Blanc quits. Files the user downloads stay on disk.

connections.qualification: A fresh profile presents usage measurement and search suggestions preselected on, and sends neither until the user saves the setup choices; both can be turned off then or later in Settings. Usage measurement carries no URLs, searches or page contents.

glance.qualification: Glance shows a second open tab of the same window beside the main page in wide windows and below it in narrow ones.

startPage.qualification: Four Start Page layouts: Ledger, Billboard, Shelf and Tally. Time-of-day wallpaper (newtabDynamicWallpaper) is off by default and, when turned on in Settings → General, follows the computer's clock through dawn, day, dusk and night.

onePassword.qualification: Public copy names macOS only: Windows and Linux stay unannounced under the waiver in docs/1password-integration.md. Off by default, explicit-invoke only, and it needs the 1Password app and account. Blanc has no password manager of its own and imports or saves no passwords.

importChromium.qualification: Bring Your Tabs reads the saved session of a Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi or Chromium profile on this computer, opened read-only, and the user picks the tabs; it can keep tab groups and pins. Favorites import reads the same profile's bookmarks, read-only, or an HTML bookmarks file. Sign-ins, passwords, history and cookies are not moved. Favorites is Blanc's name for bookmarks.

importArc.qualification: Arc import reads the sidebar file without changing it: chosen Spaces become Blanc spaces with pinned tabs, Today tabs and folders as tab groups, and top-row Favorites go into one Favorites folder named Arc. Sign-ins, passwords, history, archived tabs, Notes and Easels are not moved. On Linux the user chooses a StorableSidebar.json copied from a Mac or PC.

tabHandoff.qualification: The Safari and Firefox companions send one window's open tabs once: up to 100 tabs, address, title, order and the active tab, encrypted on the user's computer before upload. Groups and pins do not come over.

defaultBrowser.qualification: Settings → General → Make default…: macOS asks the user to confirm; on Windows it opens Windows Settings at Default apps and needs the installed build; on Linux Blanc cannot set itself and the steps differ between desktops. First-run setup also offers it.

sync.qualification: Optional, end-to-end-encrypted sync of Favorites, settings and optional per-device open-tab snapshots between the user's computers, with a passphrase the server never sees. History, downloads, permissions, passwords and private tabs never sync. Desktop only.

passkeys.qualification: On macOS with Touch ID, Blanc creates device-bound passkeys in the Secure Enclave. It does not read passkeys saved in other credential managers.

languages.qualification: Blanc translates its own interface into the six listed languages; it does not translate web pages.

engine.qualification: Public v1.34.0 runs official Electron 44.5.1 (Chromium). Official Electron ships no Widevine CDM, so protected streaming does not play: the owner confirmed on October 15, 2026 that a Netflix title stops at error M7701-1003. Never hint at future streaming support. Blanc does not install Chrome Web Store extensions.

patron.qualification: Every feature, including Blanc Spaces, is free. Blanc Patron is optional support at US$30 a year or US$4 a month plus applicable tax, and unlocks nothing.

quietTabs.qualification: Quiet Tabs discards the renderer of an eligible idle background tab (Settings → General → Quiet inactive tabs, default 1h) and rebuilds it when the tab is activated, so the page reloads. Capturing, loading, prompt-pending and tabs with unsaved form changes stay awake.
